generationMethod: authored by hand from the implementation, the cited datasets and the recorded validator run on 2026-11-03; no generator script produces this file
scope: The subset of MC-17 handoff inputs that the documentation package can establish from evidence: design-system contracts, component count, preview commands and the commercial CTA restrictions MC-18 must inherit. It does not authorise MC-18 and records no result for it.
knownLimitations: Only contracts, component count, preview commands and CTA restrictions are established here. Visual, responsive, performance, visual-regression and accessibility-audit evidence now exist and are recorded in D13/D14/D16 and their datasets (responsive-evidence.json, performance-evidence.json, visual-regression-evidence.json, accessibility-requirements.json); this file does not duplicate them.
Component counts are the counts recorded in component-registry.json and verified against the implementation by check MC17-12; a later registry change makes this file stale.
The recorded validator run at 4a9043b is PASS, 38/38. Earlier FAIL snapshots (31/38 and 36/38 during authoring) are historical. This handoff is READY_WITH_NAMED_GAPS, not a milestone pass.
No MC-18 code, route, page or test exists; mc18Started and mc18ImplementationPresent are false by observation, not by policy alone.

preview.isolation: Separate Angular project outside src/; own output path; loads preview/catalogue.css plus the generated token CSS only; production styles remain ['src/styles.scss'] and contain no MAREA reference

stateSemantics.DISABLED: Defined entity with no authorised public action; non-interactive status plus explanation.
stateSemantics.COMING_SOON: Conditional/defined edition with an internal plan but no approved date; informational text only.
stateSemantics.REQUEST_INFORMATION: Informational surface; a contact route would require consent and authorised copy.
stateSemantics.QUOTE_ONLY: Installation package, contracted solution or quotation-required entity; human survey/quotation process only.
stateSemantics.NOT_AVAILABLE: Safety/legal/gate block, retired or out-of-scope entity; explicit unavailability statement.

invariants: deriveCommercialPresentation() returns purchaseActionAllowed=false, cartAllowed=false, priceVisible=false and availabilityVisible=false unconditionally.
A release gate that is not explicitly open is closed; there is no MC-17 path that opens it.
Unknown or malformed CTA input resolves to NOT_AVAILABLE (sanitizeCtaState).
marea-commercial-cta renders no button, anchor or role=button element.
State is always accompanied by text and a shape-coded icon; colour never carries the meaning alone.
Disabled controls use aria-disabled with a visible reason via aria-describedby and remain keyboard discoverable.
State identifiers are internal enums, not public marketing labels; no authorised public copy exists.

blockedSignalPresentation.BUY_CTA: Rendered as a critical notice; the signal is neutralised, never honoured.
blockedSignalPresentation.CART: Rendered as a critical notice; no cart exists.
blockedSignalPresentation.PRICE_VISIBILITY: Rendered as a critical notice; no amount is representable.
blockedSignalPresentation.AVAILABILITY_VISIBILITY: Rendered as a critical notice; no quantity is representable.

mc18MustInherit: No purchase path, price, stock, cart, checkout, subscription or entitlement grant.
No public MAREA brand use, mark, lockup, registered or unregistered trademark symbol.
No Product/Offer/price/availability/rating structured data for MAREA.
No deployment, indexation or sitemap entry for any of the 23 proposed routes.
WCAG 2.2 AA is a target verified per surface by evidence; no conformance claim exists.
Instrument mode contrast is a software computation over declared values; hardware validation stays BLOCKED.
Inherited blockers stay inherited (see blocker-register.json); MC-18 may not close them.
